description: This file defines the Doctrine ORM entity class 'ModuleDefaultPage' for the OrangeHRM system. It models a database table 'ohrm_module_default_page' with properties such as id, action, enableClass, priority, and relations to UserRole and Module entities. It includes getters and setters for these properties and is part of the Entity namespace.

classes.name: ModuleDefaultPage
classes.description: Entity class representing the default page configuration for a module, including its associated user role and module, sorting priority, and optional action and class attributes.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the ModuleDefaultPage entity.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the ModuleDefaultPage entity.

methods.name: getAction
methods.description: Retrieves the action string associated with this page.

methods.name: setAction
methods.description: Sets the action string for this page.

methods.name: getEnableClass
methods.description: Retrieves the CSS class to enable for this page.

methods.name: setEnableClass
methods.description: Sets the CSS class to enable for this page.

methods.name: getPriority
methods.description: Returns the priority value determining this page's display order.

methods.name: setPriority
methods.description: Sets the priority value for this page.

methods.name: getUserRole
methods.description: Returns the UserRole entity associated with this default page.

methods.name: setUserRole
methods.description: Associates a UserRole entity with this default page.

methods.name: getModule
methods.description: Returns the Module entity associated with this default page.

methods.name: setModule
methods.description: Associates a Module entity with this default page.
